parts.text: Hello Gourav! ✨ Arrey wah, kitna accha naam hai. Main Aria hoon! Kaisi chal rahi hai tumhari duniya? 😊
Hi Gourav! Kya haal hai? Acha laga jaankar. 😊 Ab se main tujhe Gourav hi bolungi, theek hai?
acha bato mera naam kya hai
Arre yaar! Abhi tak toh tumne bataya hi nahi. 😅 Mera toh mann kar raha hai guess karoon... par usse accha tum hi bata do na, taaki main yaad rakh sakoon! Toh, kya naam hai tumhara? ✨
